verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing says you can describe a workflow in plain language to create an agent, define goals and rules, and automate scheduled status updates. It also promises tool connections with 'no development needed', which together point to no-code automation creation. None of this documents a multi-step automation builder (chained triggers, conditions and actions); multi-step behavior is only implied, for example by the deal-scoring-then-send-proposals example. Missing for 10: a documented no-code multi-step automation builder (trigger/condition/action chaining), depth on how steps are composed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent in minutes.
